patterns.note: A high-contrast palette featuring a dominant dark olive/black background with a vibrant neon green accent used for highlights, text, and interactive elements.
Full-bleed imagery and video sections are used prominently, often with large, impactful typography overlaid, creating an immersive visual experience.
Headings utilize a bold, condensed sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, to convey a strong, energetic, and modern brand voice.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The initial hero section features a large, dynamic image or video that scrolls up to reveal the subsequent content, creating a sense of depth and progression.
The main content area is often framed by distinct neon green borders or background sections at the very top and bottom of the page, creating a unique visual container.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed image or video that is fixed or scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax-like effect as the user scrolls down.

Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards from the bottom as they become visible within the viewport, likely orchestrated with CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the page, transitioning its background from transparent over the hero to a solid dark color once it scrolls past the initial hero content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and condensed sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with airy hero sections and more dense product grids, maintaining clear visual separation between content blocks.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with an aggressive and energetic aesthetic, primarily driven by the high-contrast pairing of a deep, almost black olive background with a vibrant, almost fluorescent neon green accent. The bold, condensed typography and dynamic, full-bleed hero sections create an immersive and impactful brand experience that feels both modern and distinctive.
